sys_script_client.description: Two behaviours for x_casemgmt_case, both from QA Issue 17. FIRST, it puts the form back in step with the database after an aborted submit: the platform re-renders an aborted save with the POSTED values, so setting Status to Draft on an Open case and pressing Update leaves the form showing Draft even though the write was refused with the verbatim "Cases cannot be returned to Draft." and nothing was persisted. The block reads the stored status published on g_scratchpad by the display Business Rule ../business_rules/x_casemgmt_case_display_stored_state.xml, which obtains it by re-reading the row from the database by its own sys_id, and calls g_form.setValue('status', stored) only when the rendered value and the stored value disagree. Fail-safe: no scratchpad, an empty or unrecognised value, status absent from the form, values already equal or any exception are all silent no-ops that change nothing. It clears no message and does not reload: AAP Section 0.5.5 requires the blocking error to stay on the form, and g_form.setValue does not touch the message area. It runs before the lockdown below so the terminal-status test is made against the stored status and so the control is corrected before it is made inert. SECOND, the terminal-state form lockdown: on load, when status is Closed, disables the ten writable fields (subject, type, status, priority, description, requester_name, requester_email, assigned_group, assigned_agent, pending_reason) through g_form.setDisabled, and additionally sets the DOM disabled property on Choice controls because the platform's client-side read-only treatment sets only the inert HTML readonly attribute on a select. Backs up ../ui_policy/x_casemgmt_case_closed_readonly.xml, whose description action has no runtime effect on this release: measured on CASE9000006, g_form.isDisabled('description') returned false and the textarea was editable while the other nine fields were protected, correlating with the platform's repeated "renderNACMFieldLevel is not defined" text-area exception in runBeforeRender. Does not touch a non-Closed form (early return) and does not remove the Update verb, because AAP Section 0.5.5 requires the blocking message "Closed cases are terminal and cannot be modified." to be surfaced on an attempt. Enforcement of the rule itself remains server-side in ../business_rules/x_casemgmt_block_terminal_closed.xml; this record governs only what the form presents. Per AAP Sections 0.4.4, 0.5.5 and 0.7.2.
sys_script_client.name: x_casemgmt_case_closed_readonly_enforce
